question: What site-level fish and natural-diet evidence does the 2007 Ormoc Lake Danao and Tubod River guide actually document, and what remains unresolved?

waterbodyIdentity.outlet: Inawasan River, described by the article as Tubod River's outlet
waterbodyIdentity.disambiguation: Do not merge this Ormoc City lake and river system with Lake Danao in Polangui, Albay or on Pacijan Island, Cebu.
waterbodyIdentity.geometryDecision: No coordinates or polygon derived. The PDF's printed coordinate strings are malformed in places and do not provide a reliable station-level species crosswalk.

article.citation: Weliange, W. S., Pogosa, J., Lankaadikara, C., Leichtfried, M., & Goltenboth, F. (2007). Guide to the fresh water fishes in Tubod River, Lake Danao and Inawasan River in Leyte, Philippines. Annals of Tropical Research, 29(2), 1-27. https://doi.org/10.32945/atr2921.2007.
article.reviewMethod: The official 27-page PDF was retrieved to a temporary directory and visually reviewed page-by-page from rendered page images. No page image or PDF text was copied into the repository.
article.studyContext: The guide says it was prepared during International Tropical Ecology workshops in 2001-2003. It describes locality-specific collection methods in the accessible methods section but does not provide individual fish collection dates, standardized effort, a specimen-by-station table, or a voucher catalogue crosswalk.
scopeNotes: Tubod River sampling is described from the upstream bunk-house area toward Cienda; Lake Danao sampling is described as nearshore; the Inawasan outlet sample is described as a short stream reach.

The paper reports different gears by waterbody, including harpoons, traps, gillnets, beach seine and night angling, so the resulting names are gear- and habitat-dependent historical observations rather than a standardized complete census.
No exact lake or river boundaries were extracted from this guide.

internalCountAndCitationIssues.issue: The abstract reports 21 total freshwater taxa and site counts of 18 in Tubod River, 4 in Lake Danao and 1 in Inawasan River; those counts total 23 site incidences.
internalCountAndCitationIssues.crosscheck: Sixteen profiles contain explicit locality statements. Five profile statements name Lake Danao, while the abstract gives a count of four. The guide does not explain whether site counts overlap or reconcile the mismatch.
internalCountAndCitationIssues.decision: Keep each printed statement in research notes. Do not assume the site totals are disjoint, silently select one count, or claim complete per-waterbody inventories.

internalCountAndCitationIssues.issue: The 2023 Lake Danao assemblage paper cites the 2007 guide for Lake Danao Cyprinus carpio and Clarias batrachus context.
internalCountAndCitationIssues.crosscheck: Cyprinus carpio is not among the 21 taxa printed in the guide. The guide's Clarias batrachus profile names Tubod River, not Lake Danao. This does not independently verify either Lake Danao claim from the 2007 source.
internalCountAndCitationIssues.decision: Record as a citation-to-source mismatch for follow-up; do not create a carp occurrence from the 2007 guide or treat its Clarias profile as a Lake Danao locality.

dietEvidence.sourceContext: The introduction says food habits and habitat were investigated, but some species profiles explicitly credit FishBase for diet notes. The provenance of individual notes is therefore mixed or unclear without checking the cited underlying work.

examplesAsResearchLeads.sourceNote: The profile describes phytoplankton, macrophytes, zooplankton and pollen and explicitly references FishBase.
The profile lists aquatic insect stages and diatoms; do not assume this is a site-specific gut-content result.
The profile includes shrimp and small gobies among foods; verify the cited basis before using as local diet evidence.
The profile includes insects, diatoms and filamentous algae; the guide does not establish a current local diet survey.

dietEvidence.decision: These are historical literature notes, not local bait recommendations or approved Bangwit diet cards. A dedicated diet study and provenance crosswalk are required before app publication.

proceedingsDiscovery.discoveryResult: A bounded exact-title/public-web search located citation records and a general institutional report confirming the tenth workshop was hosted by Leyte State University, but did not locate a standalone copy of these three fish papers or their proceedings pages.

searches: Exact titles with site:vsu.edu.ph and site:atr.vsu.edu.ph
Exact Lake Danao/Inawasan title with site:repository.vsu.edu.ph
The 2007 guide's indexed references page and Weliange's public curriculum vitae
targetedCatalogSearch.result: The public author CV independently repeats the 2002/2005 bibliography and confirms the 9th workshop was held at Leyte State University in August-September 2002. The indexed 2007 article repeats the proceedings references. These are bibliographic corroboration, not copies of the underlying fish papers; targeted queries did not surface a standalone file or catalog item.
targetedCatalogSearch.nonDiscoveryLimit: Search-engine non-discovery is not proof that the proceedings or papers are unavailable in a physical or unindexed institutional archive.

proceedingsDiscovery.decision: Treat proceedings as retrieval leads only. No species, diet, date, station, voucher or reuse claim was extracted from the unavailable papers.

rightsAndPublication.recordedTerms: The item-specific VSU journal record displays CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the same journal site's footer displays CC BY-NC-ND.
rightsAndPublication.conflict: The two displayed license notices differ. Clarification is needed before any copied/adapted article content is published.
rightsAndPublication.copiedMaterial: No article prose, profile descriptions, illustrations or PDF page images were copied into Bangwit. This file retains bibliographic facts and source-attributed scientific names and review conclusions only.

decision.historicalResearchEvidence: The guide itself prints 21 names, 16 profiles with explicit locality statements, five without, and several unresolved source-count/citation inconsistencies.
decision.currentPresence: Not established beyond the guide's historical research context.
decision.completeness: Not established; mixed gears, missing locality assignments, malformed coordinates and unreconciled counts limit the inventory.
decision.acceptedTaxonomy: Not established; names preserved as printed and not crosswalked to voucher specimens in this review.
decision.diet: Historical mixed-provenance leads only; no app diet card or bait suggestion.

nextActions: If an unindexed physical or institutional copy of the 2002 Tubod River feeding-ecology paper or 2005 Lake Danao/Inawasan proceedings papers becomes publicly accessible, verify the bibliographic record, methods, site allocation, food-study methods, vouchers and reuse terms before expanding the registry.
Do not send access inquiries without explicit authorization; continue the Eastern Visayas sweep using independently inspectable sources while these proceedings remain citation-only leads.
Reconcile the 2007 abstract and profile locality counts and the 2023 guide citations only through inspectable source text or voucher-level evidence; do not infer a correction.
Keep this historical guide separate from current occurrence, safety, rules, catchability and app-publication evidence.
